items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: I've heard of him, you know, playing at several debutante parties.

ctx.x: Yeah, mostly New Orleans people, of course. But, I don't know, all my friends like it. And I think it's still popular in New Orleans. They say that rhythm and blues is really popular, but I don't know, I like jazz much better. And down in the French Quarter now, they have several great bands that played in there. I know Al Hurt is one of them. He plays more or less progressive jazz. But, I don't know, he has some good old standards that really are good. And then, oh, there's Sharky.

Oh, Wild Bill, yeah. But, I don't know, Celestan, of course, is dead, but his band is still carrying on, and it's doing pretty well. It's still playing for parties, and they have, I don't know, all the teenage dancers now, they don't have Celestan. I don't know, he plays, I think he plays at some debutante parties now, too, doesn't he? I've heard of him. Oh, in Celestan's time? Yeah. Yeah. I've heard of him, you know, playing at several debutante parties. And, I don't know, still spell out. Okay. I'm sorry. I do.…
